function.name: calculate_tip
function.description: Calculate the total tip amount for a given total bill and tip percentage. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

bill_total.description: The total bill amount. This is a float type value.

tip_percentage.description: The tip percentage. This is a float type value.

split.description: Number of people the tip is split between. Default is 1.
